description: The Renovate policy shared by guhilling's repositories: extend it as github>guhilling/dev-conventions#vX.Y.Z and add only what is the repository's own.
Deliberate: schedule restricts when pull requests are OPENED, not when they merge.
Renovate reports 'Automerge: At any time (no schedule defined)' regardless of it.
Renovate can also be told to run directly from the Mend dashboard, so activity
outside this window is expected and is not a sign of a broken schedule.
Do not remove the schedule as setup debris.

packageRules.description: Bug-fix and minor updates merge themselves once every check is green. platformAutomerge is off on purpose: without a ruleset that requires status checks, GitHub's own auto-merge would merge before anything had run.
Major updates open a pull request and wait for a human to merge it.
